name: Observability
description: An audit trail for Orca: terminal output, text sent to terminals, agent prompts and tool calls, and workspace and agent events, streamed into a sidebar feed.

settings.title: Terminal output poll interval (seconds)
settings.description: How often the worker reads each terminal's newest output. Lower values catch more output but cost more host calls.

settings.title: Capture terminal output
settings.description: Tail every terminal's output stream into the audit feed. Turn off to record only commands, prompts, tools and lifecycle events.

settings.title: Audit feed size
settings.description: Maximum events kept in memory and shown in the panel. Older events are dropped.

settings.title: Output lines per event
settings.description: Maximum terminal output lines stored per audit event. Longer bursts are split into multiple events.
